title: Core kit
description: Shared UI + helper substrate every feature slice sits on: the ResponsiveDialog/ConfirmDialog overlay primitive (+ useConfirm), the SectionErrorBoundary, the light/dark useTheme hook, generic display formatters (fmt/ago/dt), and the ConvexError renderer (errData/ErrorLine/FRIENDLY). React-only — no Convex, no app-root coupling — so any feature that depends on `core` stays copy-clean. ErrorLine is provider-agnostic; pass a `labels` map for display names.
